## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass (CI runs them on every PR)
- [ ] Checked in **dark and light** themes
- [ ] Checked at **phone width** (375px)
- [ ] Works with the **keyboard**, and focus stays visible

<!-- For breakdowns, also: -->
- [ ] Uses theme tokens (`var(--accent)`, …), no hard-coded colors
- [ ] Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`

<!-- For content, also: -->
- [ ] `npm run content:check` passes, and `authors` includes my GitHub handle
- [ ] Sources are linked for any claims, numbers, or borrowed ideas
